title: Agents
description: Eleven agents analyse the corpus and suggest plans. Each stage builds on the reports of the one before; nothing is published without the team.

analysis.name: Analysis
analysis.hint: What exists: corpus, syllabus, learner results.

planning.name: Planning
planning.hint: Who is learning and what to do first.

corpus.name: Corpus
corpus.mission: Takes stock of the corpus: empty or overloaded modules, duplicates, lessons without content.

syllabus.name: Syllabus
syllabus.mission: Compares the corpus with the official TACTIC syllabus and lists what is missing, domain by domain.

performance.name: Performance
performance.mission: Finds the lessons and modules where learners drop out or fail most.

user_model.name: Learner profiles
user_model.mission: Describes three to five learner profiles, where they struggle and what they need next.

recommendations.name: Recommendations
recommendations.mission: Turns profiles and syllabus coverage into a prioritised action plan for the week.

create.name: Create
create.mission: Suggests the next lessons to write and generates drafts (blocks and quiz) for empty lessons.

news.name: News
news.mission: Suggests topics from economic news and links them to corpus modules.

mission.name: Missions
mission.mission: Suggests hands-on exercises and challenges matched to learners' actual level.

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.mission: Compares acquisition channels and suggests where to spend the budget.

notification.name: Notifications
notification.mission: Suggests when and how to reach learners, segment by segment.

tact.name: TACT supervision
tact.mission: Reviews every report, spots contradictions and gives an opinion on what looks ready.

legend.hint: Hover or focus an agent to see its links:
legend.upstream: solid border, agents it depends on
legend.downstream: dotted border, agents that use its reports

detail.running: The agent is analysing the data…

detail.blockedReason_one: Run the {{list}} agent first: this agent needs its report.
detail.blockedReason_other: Run the {{list}} agents first: this agent needs their reports.
detail.tactBlocked: Run at least one other agent first: supervision reviews their reports.

detail.oldDeps: Report older than {{days}} days for: {{list}}. Run them again for an up-to-date analysis.

detail.blindSpots: Not run yet, reported as blind spots: {{list}}.
detail.neverHint: All the data it needs is there. Run the agent to get its first report.

detail.noDependencies: No dependencies: this agent works directly on the data.
detail.emptyBody: The report will show here after the first run. It is also saved in the Reports tab.
detail.errorBody: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, today's AI quota may be used up.
detail.plan: This agent writes a plan (text). It does not create, publish or send anything: the team puts it into practice.
detail.planNews: No news feed is connected: the agent reasons about recurring event types (rates, inflation, company results) and quotes no figures.
detail.planNotification: No notification is sent: sending will happen from the mobile app.
detail.planMission: No mission is created in the app: the plan describes what the Create agent can produce.
detail.verdict: Advisory only: supervision does not approve, block or publish anything. The team decides.
detail.analyticsUnavailable: Learning statistics are not available: the agent will be told and work without them.
detail.demoData: Part of the learning statistics is demo data.
detail.dataSentHint: Aggregates computed on the whole corpus, not an extract of the first lessons.

inputs.corpus: Corpus totals by domain and level, and {{count}} representative lessons (those needing work first)
inputs.modules: Figures per module: lessons, published, without content, without quiz
inputs.syllabus: Official syllabus coverage by domain, and incomplete modules
inputs.performance: Learning statistics: success, hardest lessons, time spent, retention
inputs.marketing: Marketing figures: spend, conversions, acquisition cost
inputs.upstream: Summary of upstream reports: at most three findings each, with their date
